calls.title: Podme & Growthbook Technical Demo
calls.summary: The meeting provided an overview of GrowthBook’s core capabilities as an experimentation platform integrated with BigQuery, focusing on feature flagging and product analytics. Significant changes to GrowthBook's pricing model were discussed, moving from an open-source model with unlimited features to tiered plans that limit users and experiments. The team expressed concerns regarding the new limits, as they may not accommodate their experimentation needs. A no-cost proof of concept (PoC) was proposed to allow the team to evaluate GrowthBook’s value without upfront investment. Additionally, the meeting highlighted the revenue potential linked to running multiple experiments and emphasized the importance of effective budgeting for the new costs of the enterprise plan.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, feature flags, BigQuery integration, experimentation platform, sticky bucketing, pricing tiers

calls.title: PodMe & Growthbook
calls.summary: The negotiation focused on aligning the enterprise offer with the client’s limited budget and experimentation requirements. The client requested two pricing options—one for 100 experiments at a reduced price and another for 200 experiments at the same rate for flexibility. Timing for contract signing was discussed, with a proposal to delay invoicing until the first experiment launch, considering seasonal constraints. The client, new to experimentation, plans to start cautiously and scale based on results, aiming for operational readiness by October. To facilitate this, onboarding will include setup, training, and AI-assisted tools. Competitive insights revealed that the client is weighing various vendors, with GrowthBook preferred for its secure, warehouse-native architecture.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, A/B Testing, Pricing Negotiation, Onboarding, Data Warehouse Integration, Budget Constraints
